steps.title: Prepare 10% complete DMEM
steps.instruction: Filter 45 mL of DMEM (1×) through a 0.2 µm syringe filter and 5 mL of FBS through a 0.45 µm filter, combine them, add 0.5 mL Penicillin‑Streptomycin (1 %), aliquot into a sterile 50 mL graduated tube and store at 4 °C; use freshly prepared medium for all subsequent steps.

steps.title: Pre‑biopsy preparation and transport
steps.instruction: One day before the procedure label sterile 1.5 mL or 2 mL microcentrifuge tubes, add 1 mL sterile PBS, seal with parafilm and store at 4 °C; autoclave the complete surgical set (forceps, scissors, sterile gauze, sterile cotton, draping sheet); on the day of biopsy place the PBS‑filled tubes, a 3.5 mm biopsy punch and the sterilized surgical set into a UV‑light sterilizer bag, keep sealed and transport directly to the procedure room.

steps.title: Skin punch biopsy collection
steps.instruction: Position the patient prone, mark the posterior superior iliac spine (PSIS), disinfect with a sterile spirit swab then 10 % povidone‑iodine (dry 5 min, repeat swab), drape the site, draw 7 mL of 2 % lignocaine into a sterile 5 mL syringe with a 23‑G needle, inject 2 mL subcutaneously into a 1 cm area for skin anesthesia and 5 mL deeper for bone anesthesia, wait 5 min; use a sterile 3.5 mm punch perpendicular to the skin, rotate clockwise to full depth, tilt 90° to release the core, lift the core with sterile toothed forceps, transfer it into the pre‑filled PBS tube, gently invert to suspend, apply pressure with sterile gauze if bleeding, seal tube and transport to the cell culture lab within 1 h.

steps.title: Biopsy washing, dissection, and plating
steps.instruction: In a biosafety cabinet (UV 30 min, wipe surfaces with 70 % ethanol), wash the biopsy 3–4 times with sterile 1× PBS by pipetting up/down (avoid aspirating tissue); add 500 µL fresh 10 % complete DMEM to a sterile 90 mm Petri dish and place the washed tissue in it; using sterile forceps and a scalpel, remove epidermis, trim excess subcutaneous fat and chop the dermal piece into 6–8 fragments of ~0.3–0.5 mm; label a sterile 6‑well plate, scratch four small lines in each well with a scalpel, place four fragments evenly along the scratches in each well, let settle 5 min, then add 800 µL–1 mL fresh 10 % complete DMEM to fully cover the tissue, close the plate and return unused media/PBS to 4 °C.

steps.title: Culture incubation and medium changes
steps.instruction: Place the 6‑well plate in a humidified CO₂ incubator at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂; inspect daily under an inverted microscope to ensure fragments remain submerged and to monitor contamination; on day 2 add 200 µL fresh 10 % complete DMEM to each well and thereafter add 200 µL every alternate day; once fibroblast outgrowth is visible, change the full medium every second day; thaw all media, PBS and Trypsin‑EDTA at room temperature for ≥1 h before use.

steps.title: First passage to T‑25 flask
steps.instruction: In a UV‑sterilized biosafety cabinet (30 min, ethanol wipe), aspirate spent medium, add 1 mL 0.25 % Trypsin‑EDTA, incubate 37 °C for 10 min; neutralize with 1 mL fresh 10 % complete DMEM, pipette to detach cells, transfer the suspension together with the remaining biopsy pieces to a sterile 15 mL centrifuge tube, centrifuge 400 × g for 5 min, discard supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 500 µL fresh 10 % complete DMEM; add 5 mL fresh 10 % complete DMEM to a sterile T‑25 flask, inoculate with the resuspended cells, rock gently, label as Passage 1 with patient ID and date, incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ and change medium every 4–5 days.

steps.title: Second passage to T‑75 and DNA harvest
steps.instruction: When the T‑25 reaches 80–90 % confluency, repeat trypsinization, neutralization, centrifugation and resuspension as above; add 8 mL fresh 10 % complete DMEM to a sterile T‑75 flask, resuspend the pellet in 1 mL medium, transfer to the T‑75, rock gently and label as Passage 2 (discard biopsy pieces at this stage); incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂, change medium every 5 days; upon reaching 80–90 % confluency in the T‑75, trypsinize, centrifuge, discard supernatant and resuspend the final cell pellet in 200 µL PBS for downstream germline DNA extraction.
